reviews.title: Good game but not an option to improve it
reviews.text:
This game just took a nose dive.  The question in level 64 asks who gives us spiritualism? The expected answer is God! That is completely wrong! Spirituality would be acceptable but spiritualism means contacting the dead or demons. Not anything related to God! Please don’t hesitate to correct this error!
I like this game, so far it is extremely simplistic. That is fine depending on those that you want to reach. But it would be a very good idea to include an option for actual feedback, monitored by a living person. The AI does not improve the game it just doubles down on what has been put into it even if it is very wrong. Today I ran across an error that should be corrected. In level 47 the question: Who could sooth King Saul’s Spirit? The “Who” requires a persons name! Like David. But the answers were “water, pipe, harp”.  I know that is a misunderstanding of the English language - the difference between who & what. Who is referring to a person but what refers to an inanimate object.
